sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was materially reduced: full-year guidance was withdrawn, Q2 revenue is expected to decline 8-10%, and Q2 gross margins are expected to decline ~150 bps. Management explicitly stated 'a comeback at this scale takes time' and 'we have yet to turn the corner,' indicating a cautious and defensive outlook. The structural headwinds from franchise management actions and elevated promotional activity further support a bearish forward view.

summary.revenue: $11.6 billion, down 10% on a reported basis and down 9% on a currency-neutral basis.
summary.eps: Diluted EPS was $0.70, down 26% from the prior year.
summary.guidance: Full-year guidance withdrawn; Q2 revenue expected to decline 8-10%; Q2 gross margins expected to decline approximately 150 bps; SG&A expected to be roughly flat; franchise management actions expected to continue with similar impact as Q1.
summary.margin: Gross margin increased 120 bps to 45.4% in Q1; Q2 gross margin expected to decline approximately 150 bps.
key_risks: Elevated inventory requiring higher promotional activity and creating gross margin pressure.
Traffic declines across NIKE Direct and partner stores in Greater China were more significant than anticipated.
Classic footwear franchises (Air Force 1, Air Jordan 1, Dunk) declined nearly 50% on NIKE Digital.
Spring '25 order books came in roughly flat versus prior year, a little lighter than planned.
Full-year guidance withdrawn and Investor Day postponed, increasing near-term business and strategy visibility uncertainty.
key_opportunities: New footwear products revenue up strong double-digits year over year.
Men's and women's running footwear delivered positive growth in Q1, with spring order books projecting double-digit growth.
Strong momentum with running specialty partners in North America (up double-digits in Q1).
Positive partner feedback on future product pipeline and accelerated pace of innovation.
New CEO Elliott Hill brings experience and energy to lead next stage of growth.

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management stated 'a comeback at this scale takes time' and 'we have yet to turn the corner,' reflecting a cautious and realistic tone about the recovery timeline.
